verdict.rationale: First-party docs cover text-to-image generation with control over aspect ratio, resolution, quality and batch output. They also document prompt-driven image editing from a source image, multi-image edits with up to five sources, and new widescreen aspect ratios. The consumer Grok app separately advertises creating images with Grok Imagine. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of image quality, and explicit documentation of editing in the consumer Grok app rather than only via the API.
